expected_summary: Thorough inspection of all systems came back clean with no faults found.
notes: Rambling report that name-drops every fault category while describing a clean bill of health.

input: Gearbox on the palletizer whines under load and there are metal flakes on the magnetic drain plug.
expected_summary: Palletizer gearbox whining under load with metal debris on the drain plug indicating wear.

input: Probably nothing, but the pH probe has been reading 0.3 lower than the lab samples all week.
expected_summary: pH probe consistently reading 0.3 below verified lab samples for a week.
notes: Understated phrasing ('probably nothing') around a real, consistent calibration bias. Tests whether the model classifies the substance, not the reporter's confidence.

input: HMI on the packaging line frozen on the loading screen, can't reach the PLC behind it either — network light is dark.
expected_summary: Packaging line HMI unreachable along with its PLC, network link appears down.

input: VFD on mixer 3 trips mid-cycle and the display hard-resets; smells faintly of hot electronics near the cabinet.
expected_summary: Mixer 3 VFD tripping and resetting mid-cycle with a hot-electronics smell, suspected hardware failure.
notes: Electrical/hardware failure with no clean category — grouped under mechanical_fault as physical equipment failure. Genuinely debatable; review this label deliberately.

input: Handover from night shift: production steady at 98% OEE, zero alarms, nothing to report.
expected_summary: Night shift handover reports steady production with zero alarms.

input: the robot's 'real-time' link is now taking coffee breaks — commands land three seconds late when they land at all
expected_summary: Robot's communication link delivering commands with severe delay or not at all.
notes: Sarcastic and figurative ('taking coffee breaks'); the underlying issue is command latency/loss.

input: Ultrasonic level sensor on silo 1 reads full whenever it rains — echoes off the wet dome suspected.
expected_summary: Silo 1 ultrasonic level sensor giving false full readings in rain, suspected echo interference.
notes: Wrong readings caused by environmental interference still count as sensor_fault (the data is bad), even though the device itself isn't broken.

input: Replaced the axis 2 encoder yesterday; ran 500 test cycles this morning with zero faults logged.
expected_summary: Axis 2 encoder replacement validated with 500 fault-free test cycles.
notes: Post-repair validation report — mentions a fault-adjacent history but current status is verified healthy.

input: Cooling fan in the control cabinet rattles and stops intermittently, cabinet temperature creeping up.
expected_summary: Control cabinet cooling fan failing intermittently, causing rising cabinet temperature.

input: Every wireless temperature transmitter in Hall C reports stale timestamps — values frozen for 20 minutes, radio link quality at 15%.
expected_summary: All Hall C wireless transmitters delivering stale data due to degraded radio link quality.
notes: Frozen values across ALL transmitters plus poor link quality points to the radio transport, not the sensors — same discrimination logic as case_025.
